name: Bklit UI
notes: MIT for the chart components + registry; the Studio app (LICENSE-STUDIO.md, all rights reserved) is a tool and is not cataloged.

Registry index has 71 items; cataloged = 20 documented charts + documented chart utilities + 3 stat-card blocks. Skipped: internal plumbing (utils, chart-utils, chart-context, chart-parent-size, gradients, chart-animation, chart-series, chart-crosshair, bar-depth, chart-stat-flow, shimmering-text), React Native beta (native-charts) and registry:example items.

components.name: Area Chart
components.description: A composable area chart with gradient fills, tooltips, and hover interactions

components.name: Bar Chart
components.description: A composable bar chart with spring animations, stacked bars, horizontal orientation, and grouped series support

components.name: Candlestick Chart
components.description: A composable OHLC candlestick chart with gradients, patterns, tooltips, and hover interactions

components.name: Choropleth Chart
components.description: A composable geographic map chart for visualizing data across regions with interactive tooltips, zoom controls, and pattern support

components.name: Composed Chart
components.description: Mix every time-series mark — SeriesBar, Line, Area, Scatter, Candlestick, ProfitLossLine and Band — on one shared time axis

components.name: Funnel Chart
components.description: An animated funnel chart with multi-layer halo rings, hover interactions, and staggered entrance animations

components.name: Gauge
components.description: Notch, solid or sector dial (or a linear notch track) with rulers, needles, zones, progress rings, dots, glow, a center label and a zero-bounce sweep animation

components.name: Heatmap Chart
components.description: A contribution heatmap with animated cells, configurable level colors and patterns, and an interactive legend

components.name: Line Chart
components.description: A composable line chart with tooltips, markers, and hover interactions

components.name: Profit/Loss Line
components.description: Sign-colored line segments for profit and loss on a shared zero baseline

components.name: Particle Line
components.description: A LineChart series revealed by glowing WebGL particles, then handed off to a plain SVG line

components.name: Live Line Chart
components.description: Real-time streaming line chart with smooth scrolling, crosshair, and animated axes

components.name: Pie Chart
components.description: A composable pie and donut chart with animated slices, hover interactions, patterns, gradients, and an interactive legend

components.name: Radar Chart
components.description: A composable multi-series radar chart with animated polygons, hover interactions, and customizable metrics

components.name: Radial Chart
components.description: Composable radial charts — 24-hour clocks, categories and time series around a circle or a partial arc, plus angular ring bars — with dot bar, stacked bar, ring bar, line and area layers

components.name: Ring Chart
components.description: A composable multi-ring progress chart with animated arcs, hover interactions, and a reusable legend component

components.name: Scatter Chart
components.description: A composable time-series scatter chart with hover dimming, optional offset rings, jitter, and animated enter

components.name: Sankey Chart
components.description: A composable sankey diagram for visualizing flow between nodes with animated links and interactive tooltips

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: Tiny line, area and bar charts built for density — one path per chart, a shared resize observer, lightweight enter animations and a minimal hover crosshair

components.name: Sunburst Chart
components.description: A composable hierarchical sunburst chart with drill-down zoom, animated segments, breadcrumb navigation, and legend sync

components.name: Legend
components.description: A composable legend component for charts with progress bars, markers, and customizable layouts

components.name: Grid
components.description: A customizable grid component for charts with horizontal and vertical lines, edge fade, edge line hiding, and dashed styling

components.name: Background
components.description: Pattern fill for the plot area when grid lines are hidden — presets, edge fade, and enter animation

components.name: Patterns
components.description: Pattern presets for series, bands and backgrounds — PatternPreset, the full preset list, and PatternTile for custom tiles

components.name: Reference Area
components.description: Shaded Y band for target ranges and thresholds on cartesian charts — solid or pattern fill, dashed edges, and Y-axis tick coloring

components.name: Projection Line
components.description: Forecast segment extending a line series past the last data point — dashed stroke, gradient, and horizon marker

components.name: Band
components.description: Shaded range between per-row upper and lower values on a line chart — range area charts, min/max ranges, confidence intervals, Bollinger bands, and two-tone gap fills between two series

components.name: Weekends
components.description: Shade weekend days behind the series on date x axes — diagonal stripes or a solid fill, configurable weekend days, and zoom-aware rendering

components.name: Deadline
components.description: Due-date marker for date x axes — a vertical line with a striped, gradient, or solid region to its right that fades out

components.name: Trend Line
components.description: Least-squares regression line over a series on line, area, bar, and composed charts — dashed, solid, or gradient stroke with optional edge fade

components.name: Markers
components.description: Annotate dates on time-series charts — rich icon badges with a radial fan-out and tooltip, or your own minimal glyphs built on useChart

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: An interactive tooltip component for charts with crosshair, dots, date picker, and customizable content

components.name: Brush
components.description: Time-range brush for zooming area and line charts with a mini-chart strip and draggable selection handles

components.name: X Axis
components.description: Date labels for the horizontal axis in line and area charts

components.name: Y Axis
components.description: Value labels for the vertical axis in line and area charts

components.name: Stat Card Area
components.description: Revenue stat card with a gradient area sparkline, hover-to-read values, NumberFlow, and trend badge

components.name: Stat Card Line
components.description: Sessions stat card with a line sparkline, hover-to-read values, overlaid NumberFlow, and trend badge

components.name: Stat Card Choropleth
components.description: Visitor map stat card with choropleth sparkline, NumberFlow, and trend badge
